notes.title: Tentative final build
notes.notes:
[p]Hi!
We've noticed about 50% of the players are on the beta build. If you are one of those players or you want to give your opinion in relation to this post, now's the time! We are planning to stop changing the features of the game and the current beta build is the first candidate for that theoretical final build.

Here's what would still be worked on:[/p][list][*][p]Extra content[/p][list][*][p]Translations[/p][/*][*][p]Themes[/p][/*][*][p]Puzzles[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]Here's what wouldn't be worked on:[/p][list][*][p]New features[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This isn't a definitive line in the sand, however. We'd still listen to the community and private e-mails for feedback. But this would no longer be a focus. If you have something to say (especially about the latest beta build), please do so. The beta will be rolled to release on Monday if no issue arise and on Friday, the promotion to final build will be made.

We hope everything in the game is as you envisioned it and we'll be moving to adding languages and puzzles next.[/p]

notes.title: Update notes for June 7, 2025
notes.notes:
This was a loooong time coming.
Bug after bug, features that needed tweaking, etc.
Honestly, pretty much everything we've mentioned we were planning to fix/add should be in this build...
Except the theme customization. We have a good idea of what is going to be the system, but, in the meanwhile, the colors should still be better as is.

We can only apologize for the long delay, thank you for hanging in there and hope you'll enjoy this new version.

P.S.: If you were on the beta build, played the build that was pushed late on June 6, customized keys and have issues with your keys now, let us know. It shouldn't happen, but... This should not affect anyone who used a build prior or the new one.
